summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by RedCloud Holdings plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting an amendment and waiver agreement with holders of senior convertible notes issued in February 2026. The amendment adjusts the aggregate principal amount from $4,347,826 to $4,987,489 and reduces the conversion price to $0.57 per ordinary share. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or strategic review—is disclosed; rather, it is a routine debt modification. The filing relates solely to the terms of convertible notes, with no broader corporate event. No deal terms apply. As a routine financing amendment, no risk-arb angle exists.
